title: XL Condenser Kit W/ Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece
description:
The XL Condenser Kit comes with a Titanium XL condenser tube, a light wood spinning mouthpiece and all the O-rings needed to install your XL condenser kit.
Includes
XL Condenser Kit W/ Walnut Spinning Mouthpiece comes with the following.
1 x Titanium XL Condenser Tube
3 x Condenser O-Rings
1 x Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece
